decisions.reason: Chinese 〈（慈氏奴）〉 is a nested parenthetical name gloss; idiomatic English correctly renders (Cishinu) but retains a stray fullwidth 〉 from the annotation markup.
Chinese 〈（鐸盧斡）〉 closes cleanly as a nested gloss; idiomatic (Duoluwo)〉 keeps a leftover fullwidth bracket after an otherwise correct English parenthetical.
Same markup artifact as the idiomatic field: literal (Cishinu)〉 retains stray 〉 while the Chinese unit is only the gloss 〈（慈氏奴）〉.
Same corruption as the idiomatic field for 鐸盧斡: literal English keeps leftover 〉 after (Duoluwo).
淳欽皇后弟阿古只 identifies Aguzhi as younger brother of Empress Chunqin; idiomatic "the empress" drops the title-name present in the Chinese, and the repair restores it without changing kinship or lineage.
